title: 第156章 止乎礼
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾承礼心情现在还没有恢复，刚刚他差点就没控制要去亲小禾了。

这怎么能呢？君子发乎情，止乎礼，即便小禾是自己的妻子，在大庭广众之下他对自己妻子举止甚密，不仅是不尊重小禾，也是不尊重自己。

就在这时顾新礼和玉桃两个人各拿着一把伞走过来。

顾新礼看见二人就笑着道：“我看雨下大了，又没见你们两个没回来，就想着赶紧去接你们。”

玉桃连忙走向宋禾，“东家，没淋到吧。”

“没有。”宋禾摇头，然后对顾承礼介绍道：“这是咱们村幌子叔家的闺女玉桃，这次一块跟着来府城，帮忙做一些洒扫做饭的活。”

顾承礼点头，表示知道了。

“快进去快进去，这边凉。”顾新礼引着两个人进去。

顾承礼进去之后，发现这竟然还是个二进的小院子。

宋禾给他解释这间院子的来历和她是怎么决定买下的这套房子的。

“原本我想把主屋给二哥住的，结果他死活不住，非得说什么二伯哥不能和弟妹住一块，现在二哥和郑碾他们都住一进院那边的倒座房里。

玉桃住在西边耳房，货物都放在前面倒座房，西厢房现在空着，到时候可以给你改成书房，东厢房是灶房和吃饭的地方。”

顾承礼一边听着一边点点头，看向二堂哥。

“二哥，这段时间你照顾小禾辛苦了。”

顾新礼摆摆手，“辛苦啥啊，这院子是小禾买的，要不是她，我这辈子也住不了这么好的院子。”

玉桃端着两碗姜汤走进来，“东家，主家，喝点姜汤吧。”

宋禾点头，“多谢你了。”

玉桃看着宋禾，微红着脸红的摇摇头，小声道：“都是我应该做的。”

今天的东家可真好看，她还是第一次见这么漂亮的东家。

宋禾和顾承礼二人各一碗姜汤。

午饭宋禾来做，玉桃跟着在一旁学。

“炒红烧肉的时候，要先焯水，然后炒糖色。炒糖色的时候，灶膛的火一定要小，糖色炒过头就会发苦。”

玉桃连忙把火弄小。

宋禾接着道：“糖色要炒到冒泡，在泡要消的时候，尽快把肉放下去，然后加调料伴炒，之后放热水炖，一定得是热水。炖的时候还能往里面加个山楂干，山楂干里的有机酸能……”

说到这里宋禾顿了顿，“放了山楂肉就能更软烂，但不能放太多，要不然酸味就重了。”

玉桃用力点点头，她一定能学会的，以后她要给东家做一辈子的饭。

一行人众人齐齐夸这顿饭好，顾承礼也觉得好吃，尤其是红烧肉里配的黄豆。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Chengli's mood has not recovered yet. He almost lost control and kissed Xiaohe just now.

How can this be?A gentleman's feelings are based on love, but only on etiquette. Even if Xiaohe is his wife, he behaves very closely to his wife in public, which not only disrespects Xiaohe, but also disrespects himself.

At this moment, Gu Xinli and Yu Tao came over holding an umbrella each.

When Gu Xinli saw the two of them, he smiled and said, "I saw it was raining heavily, and I didn't see you two coming back, so I thought I would pick you up quickly."

Yutao hurriedly walked towards Song He and said, "Master, you didn't get wet."

"No." Song He shook his head, and then introduced to Gu Chengli: "This is Yu Tao, the daughter of my uncle's family in our village. This time we come to Fucheng with us to help with some cleaning and cooking work."

Gu Chengli nodded, indicating that he understood.

"Come in quickly, come in quickly, it's cold in here." Gu Xinli led the two people in.

After Gu Chengli entered, he found that this was actually a small courtyard with two entrances.

Song He explained to him the origin of this yard and how she decided to buy this house.

"Originally, I wanted to give the main house to my second brother, but he couldn't live in it and insisted that he couldn't live with his younger brother and sister. Now my second brother and Zheng Nian are living in the opposite room on the other side of the courtyard.

Yutao lives in the west wing, and all the goods are placed in the front room. The west wing is empty now and can be turned into a study for you. The east wing is the kitchen and dining room."

Gu Chengli nodded while listening and looked at his second cousin.

"Second brother, you have worked hard taking care of Xiaohe during this time."

Gu Xinli waved his hand, "Why bother? Xiaohe bought this yard. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't be able to live in such a nice yard in my life."

Yutao walked in with two bowls of ginger soup, "My boss, my master, please have some ginger soup."

Song He nodded, "Thank you very much."

Yutao looked at Song He, shook her head with a slight blush, and whispered: "It's all what I should do."

Today's boss is really good-looking. This is the first time she has seen such a beautiful boss.

Song He and Gu Chengli each had a bowl of ginger soup.

Song He made lunch, and Yu Tao followed suit.

"When frying braised pork, you need to blanch it first and then stir-fry the sugar color. When frying the sugar color, the fire in the stove must be low. If the sugar color is over-fried, it will become bitter."

Yutao quickly turned down the fire.

Song He continued: "The sugar needs to be fried until it bubbles. When the bubbles are about to subside, put the meat down as soon as possible, then add seasonings and stir-fry, then add hot water to stew, it must be hot water. You can also add dried hawthorn to it when stewing. The organic acid in the dried hawthorn can..."

Song He paused at this point, "If you add hawthorn meat, it will become softer, but you can't add too much, otherwise the sourness will be too strong."

Yutao nodded vigorously, she would definitely learn it, and she would cook for her boss for the rest of her life.

Everyone in the group praised the meal and Gu Chengli also thought it was delicious, especially the soybeans in the braised pork.
